description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice. It implements mobile device detection based on user agent signatures, features, and server variables, providing methods to identify device capabilities and type.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Mobile
classes.description: A class for detecting mobile devices and their capabilities based on user agent signatures and server variables, extending Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to determine if a user agent and server variables correspond to a mobile device.

methods.name: userAgentStart
methods.description: Static method to check if the user agent string starts with known mobile prefixes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with user agent, server info, and configuration, setting default features adapter if not provided.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'mobile' indicating the device type.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines device features based on user agent and server info, including capabilities like support for images, markup, and device-specific features.

methods.name: getMarkupLanguage
methods.description: Determines the markup language (WML, XHTML, HTML) based on preferred markup.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks if device has an associated phone number.
